geopolitics_summary: Iran-US conflict disrupts Strait of Hormuz; EU loosens ETS rules amid electrification push; Russia sanctions talks stall.

themes.headline: EU loosens carbon market rules, extends industry pollution allowances to 2040s
themes.why_it_matters: Lower EUA scarcity risk; weakens fuel-switch incentive from coal to gas. Reduces embedded carbon cost for power generators, pressuring forward spreads and Cal+1 power prices.

themes.headline: EU aims to double electricity use by 2040, no binding ETS target
themes.why_it_matters: Long-term demand signal supports power curve and renewable investment thesis. Non-binding ETS target reduces near-term carbon cost support; mixed signal for near-month power.

themes.headline: Strait of Hormuz disruptions continue; two-thirds normal traffic flows
themes.why_it_matters: Persistent Middle East supply risk keeps Brent elevated, raising power-plant fuel costs. Oil-to-gas switching incentive supports TTF arb margins and near-term power spreads vs. coal.

themes.headline: EU fails to reach Russia oil price-cap deal; reconvenes next week
themes.why_it_matters: Unresolved sanctions framework adds Brent volatility; if cap rises end-July, crude rallies, boosting power-plant OCGT incentive. Indirect TTF support if crude spike forces fuel-switching.

themes.headline: Global LNG trade volumes hit record 56.3 Bcf/d in 2025; US capacity expansion
themes.why_it_matters: Higher LNG supply dampens TTF via improved global arbitrage. Reduces European gas scarcity premium; lowers gas-fired generation cost and power prices, pressuring Cal+1 spreads.

watchlist: EU Parliament, member-state feedback on ETS loosening; negotiate final rule by end-Q3
Russia sanctions reconvene next week (late July); oil price-cap ratchet decision
Iran-US Strait of Hormuz de-escalation watch; Trump Hormuz fee policy clarity
Q3 EU power auctions; monitor electrification target impact on 2027–2028 capacity
